anya: spotted a 5-7pt drop in the q6b golden eval after the overnight quant canary. failing mostly on short system prompts + entity normalization.
rafa: when did the dedupe reshuffle run? could be sampling skew.

anya: can we run a small controlled rerun (300 examples) without rotation to isolate?
tyler: yes. command to reproduce pre-rotation sample: `python sample_bank.py --cohort=golden --limit=300 --rotate-seed=off --seed=2024` 
label-bot: microtask created: id=20260318-11 name=`q6b-curation-300` priority=high ETA~20h. react with :rocket: to expedite.
rafa: i'll pull the failure slice and post it to GS. pattern: prefix truncation, entity canonicalization, and answer rank flips.
kevin: can someone log the compile flags from the canary run? sometimes `int4-swap` + `kvcache-opt` causes subtle tokenization differences.
tyler: added smoke-run metadata to the bucket. uploading regen sample now and will post sha256 when done.
anya: plan: (1) regen sample no-rotation tonight, (2) label-bot microtask runs, (3) tyler/rafa compare evals tomorrow am and we reconvene 09:00 PT. if both samples fail -> quant/kernel, else sampling.
label-bot: microtask expedited by reaction, assigned to contractor-ops.
